title: Build DefectRow and SectionDivider components
description:
Create components for the defect section below features:

**1. `dashboard/frontend/components/define/defect-row.tsx` — DefectRow**
Three-column layout matching the grid:
- Column 1: Severity badge (P0-P3) + defect name (12px/500, truncate at 40 chars)
- Column 2: Status text
- Column 3: Description (line clamp 3 lines) + impact (line clamp 2 lines, or '—' in tertiary)
Severity badge colors: P0/P1 → --color-red, P2 → --color-amber, P3 → --color-text-tertiary
P3 rows: entire row at opacity 0.45
Row padding: 10px 20px
Hover: background --color-bg-card
Severity badge: --font-mono, 8px/600

**2. `dashboard/frontend/components/define/section-divider.tsx` — SectionDivider**
'Defects · {count}' label
Typography: --font-sans, 15px/600, --color-text
No gap between feature grid and divider (continuous grid feel).
acceptance_criteria:
- DefectRow renders severity badge with correct P0-P3 colors
- DefectRow renders name truncated at 40 chars with ellipsis
- DefectRow shows description with 3-line clamp and impact with 2-line clamp
- P3 rows render at 0.45 opacity
- DefectRow hover shows --color-bg-card background
- SectionDivider shows 'Defects · N' with correct typography
- No hardcoded colors outside token system
